description: A Java class providing utility functions to facilitate database access, transaction control, and SQL statement execution within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SQLProcessor
classes.description: Provides utility functions for executing SQL statements, managing database connections, handling transactions, and processing result sets within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the delegator instance associated with this SQLProcessor.

methods.name: getResultSetMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the columns of the current result set.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if in manual transaction mode.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction or sets the transaction to rollback-only if not in manual mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all open resources such as result sets, prepared statements, and connections, committing if needed.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection using the transaction factory, managing auto-commit and transaction statuses.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, optionally with specific result set types and concurrency modes.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a prepared statement query and returns the result set.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL string as a query.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes an update statement and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL string as an update.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the next row of the result set.

methods.name: execQuery
methods.description: Executes a query and processes each resulting row with a callback function.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next parameter of the prepared statement with a specific Java type, handling nulls appropriately.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next string parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next timestamp parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next time parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next date parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next integer parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next long parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next float parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next double parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next BigDecimal parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next boolean parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next object parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next Blob parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the next Clob parameter for the prepared statement.

methods.name: setBinaryStream
methods.description: Serializes an object and writes it as a binary stream to the prepared statement.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array as a parameter in the prepared statement.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests the database connection, optionally tracking connection instances if testing is enabled.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Configures the fetch size for a statement, unless using a cursor connection.

methods.name: checkLockWaitInfo
methods.description: Analyzes SQL exceptions for lock wait timeout errors and logs detailed info.

methods.name: executeBatch
methods.description: Executes batch updates in the prepared statement, returning total affected rows.

methods.name: addBatch
methods.description: Adds the current set of parameters to the batch for execution.
